subject: Restarting pilot after missed kickoff — new short slots

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff & pilot — quick 30m?

Hi Liam,

Thanks again for taking the time last week to evaluate Redwood Inference. We had you down for a 60-minute kickoff today at 10am PT to walk through the pilot plan and run a short architecture review, but I didn't see you join the call. Hope everything is ok on your end.

If now is still a window for you, I can compress the agenda into a 30-minute sync: quick goals, scope, and an action list so we can get the sandbox provisioning moving. If not, no worries — below are 3 compact options that work on our side:

- Tue 9/8, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Tue 9/8, 15:00–15:30 PT
- Wed 9/9, 09:00–09:30 PT

I've attached the one-page pilot scope and a calendar stub you can accept. If you'd prefer an async start, I can send a 10-minute recorded walkthrough and an onboarding checklist instead.

Apologies if there was a miscommunication on our calendar invite. Let me know what works and we'll adjust.

Thanks,
Marcus

Perfect — locked for Tue 9/8, 15:00–15:30 PT.

Agenda (30m):
- 5m: Introductions + success criteria
- 10m: Data residency & security controls (Evelyn will cover)
- 10m: Pilot throughput expectations and sandbox timeline (Monica will cover)
- 5m: Next steps / action items (Marcus)

Evelyn — can you confirm the high-level residency summary and whether Telestack needs a dedicated subnet for the sandbox? Monica — rough ETAs for sandbox provisioning and default RPS target?

If the CTO wants specifics ahead of the call, I uploaded a short note to the HubSpot deal and a doc in our shared drive: https://redwood-drive.internal/sales/telestack/pilot-plan — feel free to ping with any short questions.

Attached a lightweight checklist so your infra team can validate ports and auth before we hand over credentials.

See you Tuesday.

Marcus

Marcus — thanks for the run-through today, that condensed format was perfect. Appreciate Evelyn's residency notes and Monica's sandbox ETA.

A couple quick follow-ups we captured on our side:
- We'll want a confined VPC subnet for the pilot (our security team will provide CIDR and a short checklist later today).
- For throughput, we expect ~20 RPS at peak for the initial test dataset; the CTO asked for a short written note on how autoscaling behaves with sudden spikes.

Procurement — copying you to kick off the SOW redline; I'll route a PO once we have an agreed pilot scope.

Next steps: if you can send the autoscaling behavior note and the sandbox credentials ETA, we'll queue infra to stand up the subnet.

Thanks — Liam
